description: This Figshare collection publishes representative hourly electricity-demand profiles for Germany, Italy, Spain and France during COVID-19 restrictions. Six CSV resources separate weekdays and weekends, absolute and normalised loads, and percentage changes against reference demand. Work-from-home, soft-lockdown and full-lockdown phases represent increasing restriction levels. The dataset authors provide the files freely under CC0; the collection registry separately labels its descriptive metadata CC BY 4.0. These national profiles can supply reduced-demand scenarios and minimum-service assumptions for power-system resilience models. They are phase averages, not uninterrupted operational time series, and pandemic behaviour does not represent every disruption. It complements the broader operational records in data-entsoe-transparency-platform.
name: Impact of COVID-19 on electricity demand: Deriving minimum states of system health for studies on resilience
notes: G4-0277; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
